subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — aligning scope & attendees
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Hargreaves <laura.h@kinetixhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — aligning scope & attendees

Hi Laura — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the ML/infra runthrough on the calendar: 

What we heard: Kinetix wants a 60–90 minute deep dive focused on productionizing the NER/clinical-extraction pipeline: throughput targets, KV/prefix caching behavior for long clinical notes, and how we handle PHI in Private deployments. Security and MLOps will need to join. 

Proposed next step (pick one):
- Option A: Tue Jul 11, 09:00–10:30 PDT (16:00–17:30 UTC)
- Option B: Wed Jul 12, 13:00–14:30 PDT (20:00–21:30 UTC) — preferred by our infra team
- Option C: Thu Jul 13, 16:00–17:30 PDT (23:00–00:30 UTC)

Request from our side before the TDX:
1) Confirm attendees (role + name) — we typically want: Infra lead, MLOps lead, Security reviewer, Product owner, and a decision maker.
2) Share a short list (10–30) of representative prompts or a small test vector set (redacted as needed) so Marcus can prepare perf knobs.
3) Any network constraints (VPC peering, egress rules, allowlist IPs) we should be aware of.

Attachments: redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf (pdf), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you confirm Option B we’ll lock in a 75-minute slot (60m walkthrough + 15m Q&A) and add Marcus Lin (ML infra) + Neha (Customer Success) to the invite.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Laura Hargreaves <laura.h@kinetixhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@kinetixhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@kinetixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — aligning scope & attendees

Jonas — great recap, thanks. Tom (security) and Raj (MLOps) will join. We prefer Option B (Wed Jul 12, 13:00–14:30 PDT).

A few clarifications from our side:
- This is healthcare PII/PHI. We need to understand whether Redwood will be handling PHI in a VPC/private deployment or if we need an on-prem runner. Please flag what prep material you need for security.
- We can provide 20 representative notes (redacted) and a short set of acceptance prompts. I’ll share via a pre-signed S3 link (or whatever you prefer).
- Can your infra lead talk to model quantization tradeoffs? Our ops team is worried about memory footprint for long documents (20–25k tokens).

Attached: Kinetix_Security_Questionnaire.docx — please have your security/ops folks complete the sections relevant to deployment modes.

Laura Hargreaves
Head of Product, Kinetix Health
laura.h@kinetixhealth.com
Attachment: kinetix_security_questionnaire.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — aligning scope & attendees

Thanks Laura — adding Marcus (ML infra) and Neha (CS) to the thread. Option B works for our team. We recommend a 75-minute window: 60 min demo + roadmap + focused perf knobs, then 15 min Q&A/security deep dive. If you need the full 90, we can extend — let me know.

Prep we’ll do on our side:
- Marcus will prepare a short perf matrix for 1k/5k/20k token traces (quantization impact + memory curves).
- We’ll surface network requirements and a minimal allowlist for private deployments.
- We’ll fill the security questionnaire sections that apply to hosted vs private options, then flag any items we need you to confirm.

Please confirm the attendee roster with roles (we’ll build the agenda around this):
- Laura Hargreaves — Product (KM)
- Tom Park — Security
- Raj Patel — MLOps
- (Optional) Decision maker / Procurement contact
